name: Elden Henson
biography: Elden Henson (born Elden Ryan Ratliff, August 30, 1977) is an American actor. He is best known for playing Fulton Reed in The Mighty Ducks trilogy (1992–1996), Foggy Nelson in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) streaming television series Daredevil (2015–2018), The Defenders (2017), Jessica Jones (2018), Luke Cage (2018), and Daredevil: Born Again (2025-present), and Pollux in The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1 (2014) and Part 2 (2015).
